pairs.before:
Timber Window Frame and Sill Repairs

A soft sill, rotten lower frame, open joint and jammed sash are different faults even when they affect the same window. Inspect accessible timber, fixings and the opening mechanism before comparing retention, a local splice and component replacement. Enough suitable retained material and a workable connection are needed for a local repair.

Check water paths, coating failure, glazing interfaces and adjoining cladding so the repair does not ignore why the timber deteriorated. Glazing, waterproofing and major frame distortion need their own assessment and responsibilities. Period windows may also require recorded profiles and relevant heritage advice before damaged material is removed.

pairs.before:
Door Openings, Floor Levels and Cabinetry Junctions

Door clearances, jamb depth and trim profiles depend on the finished floor and wall, not only the existing opening. New flooring, patched linings or fitted cabinets can change those relationships. Measure the settled conditions before final fitting and record which existing pieces are being retained.

Coordinate cabinetry and storage with backing, openings, skirting terminations and finishing access. MEL ONE Carpentry handles its agreed cabinet and joinery scope; plumbing, electrical work, plastering and painting need their own responsible trades. A sticking door, damaged skirting or cabinet fault can also be quoted as a focused repair where a broader package is unnecessary.

Separate a local cabinet fault from new joinery

pairs.before:
Hidden and Pivot Doors: Openings, Hardware and Clearances

A concealed door needs its leaf, hinges or pivot hardware, wall lining and finished opening coordinated as one detail. Check door weight, swing, floor clearance and the way the panel joints continue across the opening. A flush appearance alone does not show that an existing wall can accept the proposed door.

Structural alterations and rated-door requirements need separately confirmed design and professional responsibilities. For a sticking ordinary door or a damaged jamb, assess the existing repair before commissioning a new concealed assembly. Detailed stair rails and balustrades also need their supports and safety role resolved; decorative joinery is not evidence of barrier performance.

pairs.before:
木窗框与窗台维修

窗台发软、下框腐朽、接缝张开及窗扇卡住，即使出现在同一扇窗上，也是不同故障。应检查可接近木材、固定件及开启机构，再比较保留、局部嵌接修补及构件更换。局部维修需要足够的适用保留材料，以及可行的连接。

应检查水流路径、涂层失效、玻璃接口及相邻外墙板，避免维修忽略木材劣化原因。玻璃、防水及严重窗框变形需要各自评估和责任安排。年代建筑窗户在移除损坏材料前，可能还需要型线记录及相关历史建筑保护建议。

pairs.before:
门洞、地面标高与柜体接缝

门的净空、门框侧板深度和饰条截面，取决于最终地面和墙面，而不只是现有洞口。新地板、修补衬板或安装柜体可能改变这些关系。最终安装前应测量已确定的现场条件，并记录保留哪些现有部件。

柜体和收纳施工须与背衬、洞口、踢脚板收口及饰面施工通道协调。MEL ONE Carpentry 承担约定的柜体与定制木作范围；水管、电气、抹灰和涂漆需要各自负责的专业施工方。不需要整体施工时，卡门、踢脚板损坏或柜体故障也可单独报价维修。

pairs.before:
隐形门与中轴门：洞口、五金与间隙

隐形门需要将门扇、铰链或中轴五金、墙面衬板和完成面洞口作为整体细节协调。应检查门重、开启方向、离地间隙及面板接缝跨越门洞的延续方式。仅有齐平外观并不能证明现有墙体适合拟议门体。

结构改动及具有规定性能等级的门，需要分别确认设计和专业责任。普通门卡滞或门框侧板损坏时，应先评估现有部位维修，再委托制作新的隐形门组件。精细楼梯扶手及栏杆也需明确支撑和安全作用；装饰性定制木作不能证明具备防护栏性能。
